verdict.rationale: OneDrive's own documented Microsoft Graph API supports UI-free programmatic operation: single-call and resumable uploads, path-based item addressing, search, sharing-link creation, delta change tracking and change notifications. Any script or CI job could drive these, but nothing documents a CLI, non-interactive authentication, or CI integration. Missing for 10: official CLI/headless tool, documented unattended (app-only/service-principal) auth for CI, CI pipeline guidance or examples, independent hands-on corroboration of automation use.
